en.text: Job again took up his parable, and said,

zhSimplified.text: 约伯又接着说：

zhTraditional.text: 約伯又接着說：

en.text: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

zhSimplified.text: 惟愿我的景况如从前的月份， 如 神保守我的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 惟願我的景況如從前的月份， 如上帝保守我的日子。

en.text: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

zhSimplified.text: 那时他的灯照在我头上； 我借他的光行过黑暗。

zhTraditional.text: 那時他的燈照在我頭上； 我藉他的光行過黑暗。

en.text: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

zhSimplified.text: 我愿如壮年的时候： 那时我在帐棚中， 神待我有密友之情；

zhTraditional.text: 我願如壯年的時候： 那時我在帳棚中， 上帝待我有密友之情；

en.text: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

zhSimplified.text: 全能者仍与我同在； 我的儿女都环绕我。

zhTraditional.text: 全能者仍與我同在； 我的兒女都環繞我。

en.text: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

zhSimplified.text: 奶多可洗我的脚； 磐石为我出油成河。

zhTraditional.text: 奶多可洗我的腳； 磐石為我出油成河。

en.text: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

zhSimplified.text: 我出到城门， 在街上设立座位；

zhTraditional.text: 我出到城門， 在街上設立座位；

en.text: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

zhSimplified.text: 少年人见我而回避， 老年人也起身站立；

zhTraditional.text: 少年人見我而迴避， 老年人也起身站立；

en.text: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 王子都停止说话， 用手捂口；

zhTraditional.text: 王子都停止說話， 用手摀口；

en.text: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 首领静默无声， 舌头贴住上膛。

zhTraditional.text: 首領靜默無聲， 舌頭貼住上膛。

en.text: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

zhSimplified.text: 耳朵听我的，就称我有福； 眼睛看我的，便称赞我；

zhTraditional.text: 耳朵聽我的，就稱我有福； 眼睛看我的，便稱讚我；

en.text: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

zhSimplified.text: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人 和无人帮助的孤儿。

zhTraditional.text: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人 和無人幫助的孤兒。

en.text: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

zhSimplified.text: 将要灭亡的为我祝福； 我也使寡妇心中欢乐。

zhTraditional.text: 將要滅亡的為我祝福； 我也使寡婦心中歡樂。

en.text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

zhSimplified.text: 我以公义为衣服， 以公平为外袍和冠冕。

zhTraditional.text: 我以公義為衣服， 以公平為外袍和冠冕。

en.text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

zhSimplified.text: 我为瞎子的眼， 瘸子的脚。

zhTraditional.text: 我為瞎子的眼， 瘸子的腳。

en.text: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

zhSimplified.text: 我为穷乏人的父； 素不认识的人，我查明他的案件。

zhTraditional.text: 我為窮乏人的父； 素不認識的人，我查明他的案件。

en.text: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

zhSimplified.text: 我打破不义之人的牙床， 从他牙齿中夺了所抢的。

zhTraditional.text: 我打破不義之人的牙床， 從他牙齒中奪了所搶的。

en.text: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

zhSimplified.text: 我便说：我必死在家中， 必增添我的日子，多如尘沙。

zhTraditional.text: 我便說：我必死在家中， 必增添我的日子，多如塵沙。

en.text: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

zhSimplified.text: 我的根长到水边； 露水终夜沾在我的枝上。

zhTraditional.text: 我的根長到水邊； 露水終夜霑在我的枝上。

en.text: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

zhSimplified.text: 我的荣耀在身上增新； 我的弓在手中日强。

zhTraditional.text: 我的榮耀在身上增新； 我的弓在手中日強。

en.text: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

zhSimplified.text: 人听见我而仰望， 静默等候我的指教。

zhTraditional.text: 人聽見我而仰望， 靜默等候我的指教。

en.text: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

zhSimplified.text: 我说话之后，他们就不再说； 我的言语像雨露滴在他们身上。

zhTraditional.text: 我說話之後，他們就不再說； 我的言語像雨露滴在他們身上。

en.text: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

zhSimplified.text: 他们仰望我如仰望雨， 又张开口如切慕春雨。

zhTraditional.text: 他們仰望我如仰望雨， 又張開口如切慕春雨。

en.text: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

zhSimplified.text: 他们不敢自信，我就向他们含笑； 他们不使我脸上的光改变。

zhTraditional.text: 他們不敢自信，我就向他們含笑； 他們不使我臉上的光改變。

en.text: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

zhSimplified.text: 我为他们选择道路，又坐首位； 我如君王在军队中居住， 又如吊丧的安慰伤心的人。

zhTraditional.text: 我為他們選擇道路，又坐首位； 我如君王在軍隊中居住， 又如弔喪的安慰傷心的人。
